added_failures_source.note: the reviewed manifest names this pair under test_logs rather than under the baseline_suite and after_suite keys the promotion suite-delta check and the review read path scan, so a read-time annotation reports the count unmeasured; this count is the set difference over the two arm logs the run itself recorded, measured in logs/added-failures-derivation.log together with its positive control, where the same function over the same two logs swapped returns the three ids

findings.text: the manifest names the two arm logs as prose in test_logs rather than under the baseline_suite and after_suite fields the store's read path scans, so annotate_review_of_run reports the added-failure count unmeasured for a run whose own logs measure it as zero, which the derivation over that pair confirms.

the guard reduces only a spelling opening with an absolute or dot component, so a head arm invoked from a directory above the repository root prints reckon/tests/x.py::t against a base log's tests/x.py::t and reads as an added failure -- the phantom the reduction exists to remove -- capping a sound run's total at the added-failures cap; the same holds for a drive-qualified absolute spelling, whose backslash normalisation at :543 shows it is meant to be handled, and only the ancestor-directory shape is recorded in the landing record as a residual.

the retirement prose is tokenised on whitespace alone, so a manifest retiring two ids joined by punctuation with no space between them, as in tests/x.py::t1,tests/y.py::t2, retires neither where the previous matcher retired both, which caps the total below the added-failures floor in the direction the plan exists to prevent; measured by calling the landed matcher and the pre-change expression side by side.

justifications.evidence: logs/base-arm-scratch.log and logs/head-arm-gate.log each open with revision, tree, module.__file__, cwd and the command and measure 3 failed against 0 failed over the same two files, and the negative control's first line carries the declared mutation verbatim, so the measure is recorded rather than claimed.
